name: io.github.stea4lth/flipvo-agent-tools
title: Flipvo: licenses, entities, NPI, OFAC and OIG screens, carriers, OSHA, drive times
description: Pay-per-call agent tools (x402, MPP): licenses, entities, NPI, OIG/OFAC screens, FMCSA, OSHA, drive

tools.name: pipe_check
tools.description: $0.001 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]. Cheapest paid call: proves wallet, 402 and receipt work (x402 only).

tools.name: drive_time
tools.description: $0.01 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/drive. Driving time/distance between two named places.

tools.name: drive_matrix
tools.description: $0.05 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/matrix. Drive-time matrix, up to 100 origin x destination elements per call.

tools.name: license_verify
tools.description: $0.02 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/license/verify. Contractor license status plus matching business-entity record. GET /v1/license/states (free) lists each served state, its source, and whether its entity is ever filled: entity is null where the state has no free registry. Some states also take `profession`; values at GET /v1/license/professions?state=. Empty licenses is a paid 200.

profession.description: FL or TX only: a licensed profession instead of a contractor. GET /v1/license/professions?state=FL|TX (free) lists them. Omit for contractors.
profession.title: Profession

inputSchema.description: A two-letter state and either license_number or name.
inputSchema.title: LicenseVerifyRequest

tools.name: entity_lookup
tools.description: $0.01 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/entity/lookup. State business-registry record (status, formation, registered agent; no officers, no street lines) by entity number or exact name. Served states: CO, CT, FL, IA, NY, OR. Up to 10 entities; empty entities is a paid 200.

inputSchema.description: A two-letter state and either entity_number or an exact entity name.
inputSchema.title: EntityLookupRequest

tools.name: nonprofit_verify
tools.description: $0.01 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/nonprofit/verify. IRS nonprofit status by EIN or exact organization name: BMF exemption subsection, deductibility and foundation codes, Pub 78 listing, and automatic revocations. Up to 10 records; empty organizations is a paid 200. No legal conclusion is computed.

ein.description: Nine digits; spaces and hyphens are stripped. Use instead of name.
ein.title: Ein

name.description: Exact organization name key. Use instead of ein.
name.title: Name

inputSchema.description: An EIN or exact organization name; optionally limit a name search to a state.
inputSchema.title: NonprofitVerifyRequest

tools.name: sanctions_screen
tools.description: $0.01 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/sanctions/screen. Screen a name against the US OFAC SDN and Consolidated lists: potential matches with list, programs, name score and reasons; optional type, date of birth and country re-rank. Fuzzy, folds accents, any script. Not a determination: an empty candidates list is a paid 200 and certifies nothing. Not UN, EU or UK.

type.description: What the party is. A mismatch ranks a candidate lower.
type.title: Type

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: a nationality or address country.
country.title: Country

inputSchema.description: A name to screen; type, dob and country only add reasons and re-rank.
inputSchema.title: SanctionsScreenRequest

tools.name: exclusions_screen
tools.description: $0.01 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/exclusions/screen. Screens a person or business name, or an NPI, against the HHS-OIG exclusion list (LEIE, Medicare and Medicaid): potential matches only, each with name score, reasons, NPI, state, specialty, exclusion type and date. Not a determination: confirm a match on the OIG online search with the SSN or EIN. Empty candidates is a paid 200. Not for employment or credit decisions. List dates and code meanings: GET /v1/exclusions/lists (free).

name.description: A person or a business. Required unless npi is given.
name.title: Name

npi.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier: an exact key.
npi.title: Npi

state.description: US state or territory code: a match ranks a candidate higher.
state.title: State

lists.description: Lists to screen. Default: every loaded list.
lists.title: Lists

inputSchema.description: A name or an NPI to screen; state only adds a reason and re-ranks.
inputSchema.title: ExclusionsScreenRequest

tools.name: carrier_lookup
tools.description: $0.03 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/carrier/lookup. US motor carrier by USDOT, MC/MX/FF docket or exact company name (FMCSA): USDOT status, out-of-service order, operating authority per docket with grant date and source (Motus, else legacy frozen 2026-05-14), BI&PD, cargo and bond required vs on file, insurance policies, BOC-3, fleet size (power_units counts every power unit, trucks and others), safety rating. Up to 10 carriers; empty is a paid 200. Not a determination: verify with FMCSA before dispatch.

name.description: Whole legal or DBA name; no partial match.
name.title: Name

inputSchema.description: Exactly one of usdot, docket or name.
inputSchema.title: CarrierLookupRequest

city.description: Exact match after normalizing case and spaces, on addresses in the requested state. Exactly one of city, zip or county.
city.title: City

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP (ZIP+4 accepted; the first 5 digits match). Exactly one of city, zip or county.

tools.name: airport_nearest
tools.description: $0.02 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/airport/nearest. Up to 5 airports with scheduled service nearest a named place, ranked by real road drive time, with IATA codes.

airport_size.description: scheduled: any airport with scheduled passenger service. large: OurAirports type large_airport with scheduled service.
airport_size.title: Airport Size

inputSchema.description: A place to search from, how many airports to return, and which airports count.
inputSchema.title: NearestAirportRequest

tools.name: osha_history
tools.description: $0.02 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/osha/history. Returns the OSHA inspections, violations and penalties on file for an employer in a state (optional city and zip), matched by name in the US Department of Labor's inspection and violation files, as establishments with a penalty roll-up; OSHA inspections only, so an employer with none has no record and an empty result is a paid 200; it is not a determination about the employer and is not endorsed or certified by the U.S. Department of Labor.

employer.description: Employer name, with at least one word that is not a generic trade word.
employer.title: Employer

state.description: US state or territory code. A hard filter on the inspection site.
state.title: State

city.description: Inspection site city, case-insensitive. A hard filter.
city.title: City

zip.description: Five-digit inspection site ZIP. A hard filter.
zip.title: Zip

inputSchema.description: An employer and the state it works in; city and zip only narrow.
inputSchema.title: OshaHistoryRequest

tools.name: npi_verify
tools.description: $0.01 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/npi/verify. For 1 to 10 NPIs, the CMS NPPES status of each (active or deactivated, with deactivation and reactivation dates), provider name or organization, practice city, state and ZIP and taxonomies, plus any HHS-OIG LEIE exclusion listed under the NPI, as facts from the files: not a credential check and not a determination about the provider.

npis.description: 1 to 10 National Provider Identifiers: 10 digits each, the last a valid check digit (Luhn over 80840 + the NPI). No duplicates.
npis.title: Npis

inputSchema.description: 1 to 10 NPIs, each 10 digits with a valid check digit, no duplicates.
inputSchema.title: NpiVerifyRequest
